metadata.title: Brent Crude Oil Prices 35.5-Year Econometric Dataset

decades.context: US Shale Oil Boom & 2014-16 Price Collapse

historical_crises.name: Gulf War (Kuwait Invasion)
historical_crises.description: Iraqi invasion of Kuwait triggered immediate oil supply shock and regional geopolitical tension.

historical_crises.name: Asian Financial Crisis
historical_crises.description: Severe economic contraction across East Asian tiger economies suppressed global energy demand.

historical_crises.name: Commodity Supercycle All-Time High ($143.95)
historical_crises.description: All-time peak driven by rapid Chinese/Indian industrialization right before the Global Financial Crisis collapse.

historical_crises.name: US Shale Boom & OPEC Market Share War
historical_crises.description: Unprecedented US horizontal fracking oversupply combined with OPEC refusal to cut production slashed prices by >70%.

historical_crises.name: COVID-19 Pandemic Declaration & Price War
historical_crises.description: Global transport lockdowns destroyed 30% of worldwide oil demand, compounded by Saudi-Russia production disputes.

historical_crises.name: COVID Market Nadir ($9.10)
historical_crises.description: Historic physical storage exhaustion and futures dislocation marked the absolute 35-year low at $9.10/bbl.

historical_crises.name: Russia-Ukraine War Invasion
historical_crises.description: Russian military operations sparked severe Western sanctions and European energy supply deficit, surging price to $133.18.
